generatedNote: GDA Ops run CONCURRENTLY, so a hero can only be in one lineup at a time. Every lineup here comes from a single GLOBAL allocation across all running ops, not from optimising each op separately (doing that double-books your best heroes and yields an impossible plan). 'Wave depth' is how far into an op's escalating waves a lineup still wins, where 100% holds the opening wave — op enemies start weak and get stronger every wave, so depth is the progression metric. Scenarios re-run the same optimisation with a constraint applied and report the cost.
